REWARDS: dense progress shaping (0.1 pickup, 0.2 open), single 1.0 terminal reward, bounded penalties; no reward loops exist because has_key/door_open transitions fire once by construction. REACHABILITY: all five states are reachable (u4 via key_lost, u3 via the goal). Minor note only: the u3 else self-loop is vacuous since the episode ends on at_goal, but it is harmless and keeps the transition function total.
